class: Production code hot-patching itself on a runtime trigger, so behavior depends on whether an edit landed mid-run
fix: New page_agent.posting_guard_refresh_modules: the running modules unless HOT_RELOAD=1 explicitly asks for a re-read; the _run_locked posting block calls it, keeping the tab reload and guard re-injection. The deliberate resume path (load_latest_code, which exists to pick up a fix the owner just made) is unchanged. HOT_RELOAD documented in .env.example (default off).
prevention: Automatic code reloading needs an explicit dev flag defaulting off; only the deliberate resume-for-fix path reloads, and it says so in the logs.
root_cause: When a posting guard denied a click, _run_locked re-read posting_entry and submission_guard from disk and re-injected the script: with no edit it was a no-op that still reset module state, with a mid-run edit the behavior depended on timing no test could pin.
symptom: The main page loop reloaded program code by itself on guard denials, making production behavior depend on file state at an arbitrary moment.
why_tests_missed: No test covered the posting-denial refresh path, and importlib.reload inside a 529-line loop body was invisible to unit tests.
